tbesh_html:
1) entrance, a coming in, entering
2) sunset
2a) sunset
2b) sunset, west
Also means: me.vo.ah (מְבוֹאָה "entry" H3997)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards
strongs_1890.kjv_def: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare H4126 (מוֹבָא).
